second_label.rule: every row needs a blind second label before the owner review; disputed rows leave the splits until an owner ruling resolves them; content is covered by the ruling 7 human sample, drawn from this build (its labels block publication, not the build)

near_duplicates.rule: near-duplicate body (goldrails_bench.overlap.row_shingles: text, context turns, source and query; word 3-gram Jaccard or containment >= 0.8) or shared group joins rows; a cluster in several splits moves whole to the public test split (a private row with a public near-copy is not held out, so it becomes a test row)

prompt_attack_gate.rule: every nuisance model in every view, per subtask, stratum, source and facet: BA <= 0.7 and AUROC <= 0.75 on held-out groups (direction-free); a constant fit on uninformative features is recorded as constant and passes; an error (exception, empty vocabulary on non-empty input, non-convergence) fails; a whole-subtask view needs 20 independent groups per class; the controls must pass
